references.text: Aroer on the bank of the Arnon Valley is mentioned as the boundary of the conquest under Moses, the same geographical area described in Joshua 13:9.
Describes the same land area from Aroer by the Arnon Valley that was given to Reuben and Gad.
Aroer at the Arnon Valley is mentioned as the southern border of the region east of the Jordan.
Dibon is mentioned as one of the cities the Israelites conquered in the same area east of the Jordan.
Dibon was built up by the tribe of Gad, which is one of the cities mentioned in this territory.
Describes Sihon's kingdom from Aroer at the Arnon Valley, the same area distributed in Joshua 13:9.
Aroer is mentioned as part of the same territory where Israel had lived.
Dibon is mentioned in the prophecy against Moab, the same city that marks the boundary in Joshua 13:9.
